newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM upgrades Sarawak Oil Palms facility.
newsitem.headline: RAM upgrades Sarawak Oil Palms facility.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia (RAM) said on Friday it has upgraded to P2 from P3 the 20 million ringgit revolving underwriting facility of Sarawak Oil Palms Bhd.

The rating upgrade takes recognition of the company's strong financial profile which has been strengthened by favourable crude oil palm (CPO) prices in 1995 and continual efficient estate management, RAM said in a statement.
"Debt coverage was excellent stemming from strong operating cashflow," the agency said.

Full-year results for the 1996 financial year are expected to mirror that of the previous year, as higher production and extraction rates and forward selling are expected to offset the lower CPO prices in 1996, it said.
Sarawak Oil Palms reported a 57 percent rise in operating profit to 22.1 million for the year ended December 31, 1995.
Its strong balance sheet would provide the company with the capacity to withstand potential adverse turns in CPO prices and ensure timely interest servicing and repayment of debt," RAM said.
